    Returns

    Easy returns - so you can shop with confidence.

    How to return your order

    1. Register your return
    Start your return through our returns portal.
    You’ll be guided through the process step by step.

    2. Send your items back
    Choose a return option that works for you and follow the instructions provided.
    • Make sure your items are securely packaged.
    • Always keep your proof of postage.
    3. We’ll take care of the rest 
    Once your return arrives, we’ll process it as quickly as possible. 
    • Please allow up to 14 days from receipt for your return to be processed  
    • You’ll receive an email confirmation when your return has been processed. 

    Returns Policy 

    • You have 60 days from receiving your order to register a return  
    • UK returns are free of charge  
    • International return costs are the responsibility of the customer  
    • Items must be returned in pristine condition, with all tags intact  
    For hygiene reasons, we cannot accept returns on: 
    • Underwear  
    • Face masks  
    • Any item with a removed hygiene seal  
    All returned items remain your responsibility until they reach our warehouse, so we recommend keeping your proof of postage. 

    Refunds 

    • Returns typically take 7–10 days to arrive at our warehouse (please note this could be longer for international returns)  
    • Once received, your return will be quality checked 
    • Following inspection, refunds will be processed back to the original payment method within 5-7 working days.

    Exchanges 

    We do not offer direct exchanges. 
    If you need a different size or item: 
    1. Return your original item  
    2. Place a new order  

    Delivery & Return Costs 

    • UK returns are free when using our returns process  
    • International return shipping costs are not refunded 
    • We do not refund postage costs for unwanted items  
    If an item is returned as faulty but no fault is found, return postage costs will not be refunded and redelivery charges may apply. 

    Frequently Asked Questions 

    Do I have to pay to return my order? 

    • UK: Returns are free when using our returns process  
    • Rest of World: Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer  

    How long does it take to process a return? 

    Once your return arrives at our warehouse, please allow up to 14 days for it to be processed.

    What should I do if I receive an incorrect item? 

    If you’ve received the wrong item, please contact our Customer Service team through our contact us page with your order details.


    We’ll work quickly to resolve the issue.

    What should I do if my item is damaged? 

    Please accept the delivery and contact us as soon as possible with: 

    • Details of the issue  
    • Photos of the damage  

    We’ll review your case and provide a resolution. 

    How do I report a faulty item? 

    Contact us via our contact us page with: 

    • A description of the fault  
    • Images where possible  

    We’ll investigate and guide you through the next steps. 

    Can I exchange an item? 

    We currently do not offer exchanges.
    To get a different item, return your original order and place a new one.

    Will I be refunded my return postage costs? 

    • UK: Returns are free using our returns process  
    • Rest of World: Return postage costs are not refunded.   

    If no fault is found, postage costs will not be reimbursed.

      We Value Your Privacy

      We use cookies on this site to improve functionality, personalise your browsing experience, analyse site usage, and for marketing and personalised advertising. Learn more
      Opt-Out Request Honored

      Privacy Preference Center

      When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
      More information

      Manage Consent Preferences

      Performance Cookies

      These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

      Functional Cookies

      These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

      Strictly Necessary Cookies

      Always Active

      These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

      Targeting Cookies

      These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
